recognize_zh: 這是染色體部分核型圖（非型態圖）：左側比對正常 14 號與 inv(14)(q11q32.1)，箭頭標出 q11 與 q32.1 斷裂點；右側比對正常 8 號與 i(8q) 等臂染色體，是 T-PLL 最具代表性的細胞遺傳異常組合。
features: Partial G-banded karyogram comparing normal chromosome 14 with inv(14)
Arrows mark breakpoints at 14q11 (TRA/TRD locus) and 14q32.1 (TCL1A locus)
Altered banding pattern of the inverted 14 long arm compared with the normal homolog
Normal chromosome 8 beside an isochromosome 8q with two identical long arms and loss of 8p
Blue horizontal line aligns centromeres for comparison
describe_en: This is a non-morphologic cytogenetic figure showing selected G-banded chromosomes aligned at the centromere. The first pair compares a normal chromosome 14 with an inverted chromosome 14, with breakpoints marked at q11 and q32.1, corresponding to inv(14)(q11q32.1). The second pair compares a normal chromosome 8 with an isochromosome 8q, i(8q), which consists of two long arms and no short arm. inv(14)(q11q32.1) juxtaposes TCL1A with the T-cell receptor alpha/delta locus and, together with i(8q), is the characteristic cytogenetic signature of T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia.
